overview: The period concentrates on simulation-based inference and neural surrogates — conditional normalizing flows for DESI DR1 tomographic N(z), Fourier and spherical neural operators for MHD turbulence and 21cm lightcones, and generator networks for data-efficient cosmology simulation — alongside generative forward models for lensing (SHINE, CosmoSim) and Euclid DR1 strong-lens selection (15,072 candidates). Gravitational-wave work covers neural posterior estimation for tests of general relativity, EMRI inference and LISA glitch classification. LLM agents, literature-mined catalogues (DarkMatterFM-Registry, GalaxyWiki) and survey homogenisation (Survey of Surveys DR3) also feature.
themes: Strong-lens detection and generative lens modelling
